items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: He said if I show him how to do it, he learned me how to read. That's the first time I ever read a note. He gave me my first lessons of how to read

ctx.x: I was going to ask too about any regular formal lessons, if you, when you learned to play drums, did your brother show you how to hold the sticks a little bit, or did you ever have a book that you learned in? No, he showed me how to hold the sticks.
The first time I ever learned how to read a note was there on Chicago. Jimmy, a fellow by the name of Jimmy Burtrain.
